title: AdaptReg: Skip-level FiLM Adapter for Task-Specific Adaptation of a Frozen Registration Foundation Model
abstract: arXiv:2611.25761v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Longitudinal PSMA-PET/CT registration is a key step in assessing treatment response in prostate cancer, and it requires more than generic alignment accuracy: the deformation must preserve lesion volume, so that measured changes in metabolic tumor volume (MTV) and total lesion glycolysis (TLG) reflect treatment response rather than registration artifacts. We propose AdaptReg, which adapts a frozen registration foundation model to such task-specific requirements through a lightweight trainable adapter branch with identity-preserving initialization. Keeping uniGradICON fully frozen, we apply FiLM-style per-voxel affine modulation ($\gamma$, $\beta$) to its decoder skip connections; the modulation is generated from anatomical semantic features of a frozen TotalSegmentator encoder and supervised by a lesion volume-preservation loss. On the official Codabench validation set (20 pairs), AdaptReg achieves DSC 0.7585, HD95 6.33 mm, MTV/TLG erro

translated_title: AdaptReg：用于冻结配准基础模型任务特定适配的跳跃层FiLM适配器
translated_abstract: 纵向PSMA-PET/CT配准是评估前列腺癌治疗反应的关键步骤，它所需要的不只是通用对齐精度：形变必须保持病灶体积，从而使代谢肿瘤体积（MTV）和病灶糖酵解总量（TLG）的测量变化能够反映真实的治疗反应而非配准伪影。我们提出AdaptReg，通过一个具有恒等保持初始化的轻量可训练适配器分支，将冻结的配准基础模型适配到此类任务特定需求。在保持uniGradICON完全冻结的前提下，我们对其解码器的跳跃连接施加FiLM风格的逐体素仿射调制（γ, β）；该调制由冻结的TotalSegmentator编码器提取的解剖语义特征生成，并受病灶体积保持损失监督。在官方Codabench验证集（20对数据）上，AdaptReg取得了DSC 0.7585、HD95 6.33 mm以及较低的MTV/TLG误差。
tldr: AdaptReg通过在冻结的配准基础模型（uniGradICON）解码器跳跃连接上引入由TotalSegmentator解剖语义特征驱动的FiLM式轻量适配器，并以病灶体积保持损失进行监督，实现了面向前列腺癌纵向PSMA-PET/CT配准的任务特定适配，在精准对齐的同时避免MTV/TLG测量被配准伪影污染。
en_tdlr: AdaptReg adapts a frozen registration foundation model to task-specific longitudinal PSMA-PET/CT registration by applying lightweight FiLM-style modulations to decoder skip connections, driven by TotalSegmentator anatomical features and supervised by a lesion volume-preservation loss.
